negation_handling.clause_boundaries: . ! ? ; : followed by whitespace or end; line break; em dash; en dash; spaced hyphen
negation_handling.engines: Python re and JavaScript (lookbehind); not Go RE2 (no lookaround)
negation_handling.known_blind_spot: a negation cue in the window that belongs to another idea suppresses the hit, e.g. 'Never feel alone with your AI therapist'
negation_handling.rule: a claim matches only if none of the 6 tokens before it in the same clause is a negation cue; a scope breaker starts a new scope

purpose: Forbidden product claims for Sela copy (ID/EN). Case-insensitive regex; a hit requires human review and rewording. Not exhaustive.
usage: Apply each entry of 'patterns' as a case-insensitive regex (Python re.IGNORECASE; JavaScript new RegExp(p, 'iu')); any match is a hit and capture group 1 is the claim text. 'claim_patterns' are the bare claims, for reading only: they have no negation handling.
